verdict.rationale: Sentry's own AI agent, Seer, provides Autofix, which automatically scans incoming issues and finds root causes. The marketing page claims it can 'Automatically root-cause any issue', and Seer Agent answers questions about the application from telemetry. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of root-cause accuracy, in-depth documentation of how root-cause analysis is presented, explicit evidence of alert-triggered (versus issue-triggered) investigation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have the platform's AI investigate an alert or error and propose a probable root cause

citations.quote: Autofix: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage.
Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
fix them when they hit prod with Seer, our debugging agent and code reviewer.
